root: ^You did indeed call Frank and tell him where to stick it.
^In fact, you proceeded to tell that to everyone you met as you frolicked your way to the lottery offices to cash in your big, fat winnings.
^You sleep soundly now, dressed in silken pyjamas and snuggled in your exquisitely expensive bed, the memory of Frank breathing down your neck only a faded, distant memory.
^On some nights, you think you can still smell the faint stink of that old sushi box sitting next to your old TV.
^And sometimes, you feel tiny pinpricks on your skin, a reminder of how it felt to hold that beautiful lottery ticket that carried your lucky numbers.
^We just want to make sure you don't forget.
^And rest assured, we'll keep in touch.
